Order No. 14.11.2023 Misc. Case No.21498 of 2017 09. 1
. This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. U.C. Mohanty, learned counsel appearing for the Applicant/Opposite Party No.4, Mr.
Bharat Jalli, learned counsel appearing for the writ Petitioner and Mr. L. Samantray, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.
3.

This application has been filed by Opposite Party No.4 seeking recall of the order dated 24th October 2016, by which this Court disposed of W.P. (C) No.14368 of 2016 with the following order:
"4. Considering the above, this Court disposes of this writ petition with a direction to the Land Acquisition Officer-cum-Competent Authority, National Highway Authority of India, Chhatrapur- Opposite Party No.2 to assess the compensation amount in respect of the fruit bearing trees removed from the acquired land of the Petitioner, on the basis of the report submitted by the Horticulturist, Chhatrapur under Annexure-3, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of eight weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order and consequential action shall be taken thereafter."
4.

Mr. Jalli, learned counsel appearing for the writ Petitioner, files an objection to the Misc. Case filed by Opposite Party No.4 for modification/recalling the order dated 24th October, 2016, which is taken on record.

He raises an objection that in a disposed of writ petition, the said misc. Case is not maintainable and, as such, the same may be dismissed and otherwise, it is argued that when the direction in the order dated 24th October, 2016 is for assessment of compensation, the question of recalling the said order does not arise.
Swarnaprava Rath vs State Of Odisha And Others ....

sentences.text:
Opposite ... on 14 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101340664/
1 5.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after going through the materials available on record, it is seen that by the order dated 24th October, 2016, this Court directed for assessment of the compensation amount in respect of the fruit bearing trees removed from the acquired land of the Petitioner on the basis of the report submitted by the Horticulturist, Chhatrapur under Annexure-3 as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of eight weeks.

Therefore, when a direction has been given for assessment of the compensation amount with regard to removal of the trees available on the land acquired, the question of recalling the said order does not arise.
6. In view of such position, the Misc. Case filed by Opposite Party No.4 cannot be sustained, and the same is liable to be dismissed and it is hereby dismissed.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE (M.S. RAMAN) JUDGE S. Behera/ M. Panda Designation: Senior Stenographer
